sentences.text: In his own telling, one did not take a camera anywhere in those days, one accompanied the outfit: a camera the size of a soap box, a tripod strong and heavy enough to support a bungalow, a dark-tent, glass plates, and a bath of silver nitrate, which he called the most awkward travel companion imaginable.
